mentions.name: Merrilin
mentions.description: Ebook reading app available on Android (with an iOS release coming soon) that aims to be the best ebook reading experience, built from a long wishlist of features missing from Kindle and other reading apps.
mentions.problem: Kindle and every other reading app give a sub-par reading experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: We started building https://merrilin.ai in February this year, and it's been going good. We released on Android, and we're also releasing on iOS soon. It's a passion project of ours, we wanted to build the best damned ebook reading app there is, and it bloomed from there.
